name: gittree
description: IntelliJ-grade Git integration for VS Code: changelists, log graph, interactive rebase, 3-pane merge, shelve, code review, and local history.

media.altText: The Commit tool window: Commit and Shelf tabs, folder tree with tri-state checkboxes, message editor
The commit tool window with pre-commit checks
The commit graph with filter chips
Blame annotations with an age heat-map

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build && npm run build:webviews
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.pretest:integration: node esbuild.mjs && npm run build:webviews && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json
scripts.pretest:perf: node esbuild.mjs && npm run build:webviews && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json
